scope: Native Host busy/idle admission with owned synthetic Pi processes; no production runtime or OS service changes
idle: Every owned process has an identity-confirmed ready driver, no owned turn reservation, and no pending command/model query
transition: last busy work settles under Host admission lock
stop all owned processes and persist terminal sessions
invariants: An idle process is not an active turn

Lease disconnect cancels only pending, never draining
